check.template: Run `tsc --noEmit` to type-check all TypeScript files in the project. Report any errors.

test.description: Run the full test suite with vitest
test.template: Run `npx vitest run` to execute all unit tests. Report results: pass/fail count and any failures.

test:watch.template: Run `npx vitest` in watch mode so tests re-run on file changes.

lint.template: Run `npx eslint src/ test/` to check for lint errors. If there are errors, explain them.

lint:fix.template: Run `npx eslint --fix src/ test/` to auto-fix any fixable lint issues, then report remaining unfixable errors.

format.template: Run `npx prettier --check src/ test/` to verify formatting. If files are misformatted, list them.

build.description: Full build: compile, test, and lint
build.template: Run the full validation pipeline sequentially: `npm run build`, then `npx vitest run`, then `npx eslint src/ test/`. Stop on first failure and report what failed.
